sections.title: Letter sound yu
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (ю) /ju/. Its main sound is heard in the word (юг) /juk/, which means south. This letter has four sounds in total.

sections.title: Saying yu
paragraphs: To say the first sound, lift your tongue high and push your lips forward into a small circle. To make the second sound, pull your tongue back and keep your lips in a tight circle. For the third sound, raise your tongue toward the roof, then relax it slightly as your lips push forward. For the fourth sound, keep your lips loosely circled and relax your tongue.

sections.title: Reading yu
paragraphs: At the start of a word with stress, read it as in (юг) /juk/. After a consonant with stress, read it as in (брюки) /ˈbrʲukʲɪ/. At the start of a word without stress, read it as in (юрист) /jʊˈrʲist/. After a consonant without stress, read it as in (люблю) /lʲʊˈblʲu/.

sections.title: Comparing yu
paragraphs: Do not let your lips spread wide like the vowel in you. Russian pushes the lips into a much tighter circle. Keep your lips pushed forward firmly until the sound stops.
